My father was alone
I remember one night behind that window facing God
He was staring at the horizon
He reluctantly called my mother to him
Shaking his hands
My mother shouted
Alas, no one is in need
My mother was also alone
But he never told anyone
that I am alone..
I'm lonely in the alleys and back alleys
